name: Peri
description: The peri (Persian: pari) is a winged supernatural being of immense beauty in Persian and wider Persianate folklore, originally an ambivalent or malevolent class of spirits in pre-Islamic Iranian belief and later reinterpreted as a generally benevolent fairy-like being who opposes the malevolent divs.
origin: Peri / pari traditions span the Persianate cultural world: Iran, Afghanistan, Tajikistan, the Kurdish regions, Pakistan, parts of India, the Caucasus, Anatolia, and Central Asia.
